case_control.covariate_sensitivity: intercept plus OSA indicator plus age_per_10y plus male plus BMI_per_5
case_control.covariate_sensitivity_role: secondary only; never used to select candidates, weights, thresholds, or the preferred result

paired_CPAP.design_primary: paired post minus pre equivalent to subject plus timepoint
paired_CPAP.covariates: none in the primary paired model; age and sex are time invariant, and BMI change may be on the treatment pathway

preprocessing.matrix_scale: already log2 normalized; no further log2 transformation
preprocessing.feature_mapping: retain probes with exactly one numeric GPL6244 Gene ID; aggregate multiple probes per Entrez by sample-wise median
preprocessing.sample_exclusion: all manifest primary_include=yes samples retained; technical outliers flagged but never removed after outcome inspection

protein_statistics.primary_statistic: limma-style empirical-Bayes moderated t using the same variance-prior implementation as discovery and CPAP validation
protein_statistics.multiple_testing: BH-FDR within each contrast and mapped-feature universe
protein_statistics.candidate_coverage_missingness: unavailable candidates remain explicit and are never imputed

orientation.discovery_direction: sign of frozen GSE75097 OSA-control beta
orientation.case_control_positive_interpretation: same-direction OSA state signal across blood and adipose
orientation.CPAP_positive_interpretation: adipose change opposite to the frozen blood OSA direction
orientation.node_score: within-endpoint midrank percentile of oriented moderated t among measurable primary candidates

pair_endpoints.eligibility: both nodes measurable; retain the frozen 31,125-pair rank and never rerank after missingness
pair_endpoints.pair_support: geometric mean of the two node scores
pair_endpoints.primary_case_control: top-1-percent same-direction adipose OSA-state support divided by all eligible-pair support
pair_endpoints.primary_paired_CPAP: top-1-percent adipose CPAP-reversal support divided by all eligible-pair support
pair_endpoints.AUEC: normalized trapezoidal area of top-minus-background support over frozen rank fractions 0.005 through 0.05
pair_endpoints.joint_secondary: geometric mean of case-control and paired-CPAP node scores, summarized separately as cross-study triangulation
pair_endpoints.persistent_signal_secondary: same-direction adipose OSA state with absent CPAP reversal; interpreted descriptively as persistence or residual-risk evidence, not as treatment failure

randomization.primary_node_aware: permute complete node evidence vectors within deterministic blocks of 10 nearest nodes matched on frozen detection fraction and log2 protein length; keep the pair graph and frozen ranking unchanged
randomization.case_control_subject_aware: randomly permute the 10 OSA and 8 control labels across all 18 complete participant expression vectors; recompute unmoderated node t and pair support
randomization.paired_CPAP_subject_aware: apply one random sign to the complete post-minus-pre vector of each of 24 participants; recompute unmoderated node t and pair support
randomization.P_value: (1 plus number of null statistics at least as large as observed) divided by (iterations plus 1)

multiplicity.primary_cross_tissue_family: case-control top-1-percent and paired-CPAP top-1-percent node-aware tests
multiplicity.primary_adjustment: BH-FDR across the two cross-tissue primary tests
multiplicity.secondary_family: AUEC, subject-aware tests, joint triangulation, baselines, covariate sensitivity, bottom-rank and opposite-direction controls

negative_controls: bottom 1 percent of the frozen primary ranking
same-direction CPAP change rather than reversal
model order-gap and truncation strata reported without filtering
prohibited: changing ranking weights, top fractions, endpoint orientation, covariates, or randomization after viewing GSE135917 effects
merging case-control and paired-CPAP expression matrices as one outcome model
using GSE135917 for training, calibration, threshold selection, checkpoint selection, or model selection
claiming physical PPI validation from transcript-level co-response
interpreting absent CPAP reversal as automatic evidence against a pair
